newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Shares of Brazil's CEB sold for 79 mln reais-bolsa.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Brazil's CEB sold for 79 mln reais-bolsa.

text.p: Brazil's Federal District sold Wednesday an 18.37 percent stake in CEB power firm was sold for 78.1 million reais, or eight percent above the base price, a the Rio de Janeiro bolsa said.
A bolsa spokeswoman said more than 540 million CEB preferred stock was sold to separate investors, with 509 million shares sold at 146.00 reais per 1,000 shares and the remainder at 145.99 reais.
Eleven investment banks and brokerages, including Garantia, Bradesco, Fonte Cindam and Maxim, offered at the 146.00 reais, she added.
The district had originally offered 540.97 million shares but the auction was joined by investors seeking to sell off another one million shares.

The federal district's controlling stake in CEB fell to 61.1 percent from 79.48 percent, while district-owned companies hold 12.15 percent of the firm and federal power holding Eletrobras, pension funds and private investors own the rest.
